description: Gain of predictor-defined states over the default state, paired bootstrap CI, p against the nulls

columns.name: predictor
columns.description: dimorphite_dom, openbabel, enum_popmax, ml_pka, consensus_ge3

columns.name: scorer
columns.description: vina, smina, ad4

columns.name: n
columns.description: n_common (complexes with finite scores for all seven original conditions)

columns.name: n_changed
columns.description: complexes whose chosen microstate differs from the default state

columns.name: n_charge_changed
columns.description: ...with a different net charge

columns.name: n_fallback
columns.description: complexes keeping the default state because the predictor gave no usable state

columns.name: n_score_changed
columns.description: complexes whose score differs from the default state's by more than score_change_tol

columns.name: Rp_single
columns.description: Rp of the default state

columns.name: Rp_pred
columns.description: Rp of the predictor-defined state

columns.name: dRp
columns.description: Rp_pred - Rp_single

columns.name: lo
columns.description: paired bootstrap 2.5th percentile of dRp

columns.name: hi
columns.description: paired bootstrap 97.5th percentile of dRp

columns.name: p_boot
columns.description: fraction of bootstrap dRp <= 0 (one-sided, as in the original analysis)

columns.name: RMSE_single
columns.description: OLS RMSE of the default state

columns.name: RMSE_pred
columns.description: OLS RMSE of the predictor-defined state

columns.name: dRMSE
columns.description: RMSE_pred - RMSE_single

columns.name: dRMSE_lo
columns.description: bootstrap 2.5th percentile

columns.name: dRMSE_hi
columns.description: bootstrap 97.5th percentile

columns.name: p_null
columns.description: empirical p against the preset step-2 random null (non_single pool, every complex perturbed)

columns.name: p_null_incl_single
columns.description: same with the default state in the pool

columns.name: p_null_changed_set
columns.description: empirical p against the random null restricted to the complexes the predictor changes

columns.name: n_matched
columns.description: changed complexes with a non-empty matched-|dq| pool

columns.name: dRp_matched_obs
columns.description: observed dRp when only the n_matched complexes are changed

columns.name: p_null_matched
columns.description: empirical p against the matched-|dq| null

extra.null_pool_rule: ensemble members (the Dimorphite 6.4-8.4 ensemble, truncated to 24 as in D11) other than the default (single) state, with a finite score for the scorer; the draw is uniform over the pool
